rootCause: Marked removes an optional whitespace character after a quote marker, losing the partially consumed tab and physical source column. Normalizing every body line also changes literal fenced/HTML content.
fix: Preserve quote physical columns in lexer-local WeakMap frames. Normalize structural leading indentation; protect fence and HTML bodies, and strip fence indentation using physical columns. Preserve existing list fallback and all known broader differences.

oracleAudit.disposition: Retain old report; correction comes from an additional independent reference, not from changed expected outputs.

reproduction.scope: Broad exploration includes existing list/unclosed fence and extension dialect differences. 383 differences are not fixed claims.

chrome.scope: Native Chrome rendering of actual reader trees; exact code/selection, glyph placement within one Blink layout unit (1/64px). Not pixel equality or WeChat WXML/device proof.
chrome.initial: Initial exact geometry check flagged134 cases; code/selection all exact, all glyph differences were one 1/64px Blink layout unit with zero vertical delta. Raw measurements preserved; no pixel-equality claim.

attribution.scope: The commonMark array, including the selected examples and added reader/baseline measurements, is distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0. Other product code retains its existing licenses.
attribution.changes: Reused 62 previously attributed original examples; added current structure/text comparisons.
